mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly FEDFUNDS rate above the prior 12-month average predicts a near-term negative S&P 500 20-day forward return due to tightened discount rates affecting expected cash flows.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are non-negative in at least 70% of triggered events, or FEDFUNDS change is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly PAYEMS (employment) coinciding with a falling UNRATE (unemployment rate) signals labor market strengthening, which is associated with positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >50% of such labor market events, or the correlation between PAYEMS/UNRATE change and returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly surge in GDPC1 (real private demand) accompanied by a rise in HOUST (housing starts) predicts positive S&P 20-day forward returns as market anticipates sustained economic momentum.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative despite the signal in >40% of similar events, or the joint signal's IC < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in INDPRO (industrial production) exceeding -2% suggests supply-side weakness, which is associated with negative S&P 5-day forward returns as investors anticipate soft landing difficulty.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are non-negative in >60% of such events, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains below its 2007-2020 average for three consecutive months, the S&P 20-day forward return tends to be positive as low rates encourage equity valuation expansion.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in >50% of such periods, or the low-rate effect is not captured in the returns (IC < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE below 5% followed by a sustained increase in PAYEMS predicts a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as labor market participation expands amid low unemployment.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 5 AND UNRATE < UNRATE_prev AND PAYEMS > PAYEMS_prev
regime_hint: labor market transition to full employment
failure_condition: 60-day returns are negative in >40% of such labor transitions, or interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly acceleration in CPIAUCSL inflation (rate of change) above +0.3% predicts negative 20-day S&P 500 returns as market anticipates rate hike anticipation and equity discounting.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive in >50% of such inflation events, or the effect is not statistically robust (IC < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly declines in both INDPRO and GDPC1 exceeding -4% indicate dual supply shocks, which are associated with negative 5-day S&P 500 forward returns as risk aversion rises.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < INDPRO_prev AND GDPC1 < GDPC1_prev AND INDPRO < INDPRO_prev_prev AND GDPC1 < GDPC1_prev_prev
failure_condition: 5-day returns are non-negative in >60% of such dual declines, or the interaction is not significant (p > 0.05).
